# Diagram Design provenance

Upstream: https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design

Imported commit: 2724fd2efd8c6737f6fa704fbf5da52d67375497

Skill version: 2.6. License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Cathryn Lavery.

Original SKILL.md, references/, and assets/ are copied without authorship changes under public/diagram-design/. LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md are retained at root and in that directory. Original README is preserved in docs/UPSTREAM-README.md. Original scripts remain in skills/diagram-design/scripts and scripts/.

The adapter loads the selected type reference, style-guide, output-spec, relevant primitives/semantic patterns, and one matching light/dark/full example on demand. Its curated core summary preserves hierarchy, connector, accessibility and complexity constraints. Browser export uses a static pure-SVG contract and system font fallbacks for offline fidelity; animated templates are not used for generation.

The 39 canonical types are derived from the checked-in SKILL.md selection table; activity and methodology are application aliases. Upstream is a design knowledge base, not a rendering library. Browser validation covers structural safety and simple geometry; upstream Python checks are development aids, not a browser runtime.
